verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online has a documented REST API (V3) with SDKs (PHP, Node OAuth client) supporting full CRUD, and an official-looking MCP server claiming '145 Total Tools - Complete coverage of QuickBooks Online API', suggesting strong programmatic parity with the UI. However, no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt was found (both 404), and community feedback notes QBO has historically lacked feature completeness relative to its own desktop counterpart, raising doubts about true 1:1 UI/API parity.
